title: Design: Ready for review internal work order offers no Close Work Order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Make sure the organization requires review before completion.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer with every line Complete and not yet reviewed, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-13-04b-work-order-ready-for-review.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Mark Reviewed" is offered as it is on a billable work order.
  • No "Close Work Order" button or menu item is shown.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-R7: “If the organization requires review before completion, the work order goes through Review and Mark Reviewed first, exactly as a billable one; Close is offered where Create invoice would be.”
  • S3-N2: “If Create invoice would not be offered (review on and not yet marked, or every line declined), Close Work Order is not offered either. With review off and open lines, Close Work Order sits in the three-dots menu exactly as Create invoice does today; once every line is Complete it is the header button and leaves the menu, as Create invoice does.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
